name: Canavieiras (Brazil)
description: Vertical stripes of white and green crossed by a red diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly bearing three white shells.
history: Canavieiras is a municipality on the coast of the state of Bahia, Brazil. Portuguese Wikipedia records that the flag was chosen in a 1967 contest promoted by the Lions Club and won by Jorge Silva Souza: the green stands for the cane fields and forests, the white for the beaches and the red for the robe of the patron, Saint Bonaventure; the three emblems on the band are read as crab claws or shells.

features.role: diagonal band bearing three white shells
